title: Counter-Strike Stats – CS2 Stats on Steam Profiles
description: Free browser extension that displays Counter-Strike stats directly on Steam profiles: csstats.gg Premier seasons, FACEIT and Leetify stats for CS2 and CS:GO.
heading: Counter-Strike Stats
subtitle: Displays Counter-Strike stats directly on Steam profiles.

screenshot.alt: Counter-Strike Stats extension showing csstats.gg Premier ratings, FACEIT level and ELO, Leetify aim and utility metrics and account ages on a Steam profile
screenshot.caption: Steam profile with CS2 stats

features.name: FACEIT
features.text: Level, ELO, K/D, win rate and bans for CS2 and CS:GO.

features.name: LEETIFY
features.text: Aim, utility and performance metrics compared to the average player.
